inputs: Only the four original released 211-Angstrom images per window; no in-situ speed, recurrence, EVE, magnetograms or extra solar observations as predictors.
development: Folds 1-3 fit, Fold4 validation. Fold5 members remain uninterpreted bytes until final freeze. All candidates share exact rows. Fit preprocessing on fitting folds only. Original folds1-4 were used in previous research, so these are development data.
final: One frozen five-fold pass. For each heldout fold fit on the other four, with all choices/epochs/blends already frozen. No final-test-driven candidate selection. Never output raw holdout labels or images to the agent. Report aggregate scores and fixed ablations only.
metrics: Mean fold RMSE km/s, Fisher-z averaged fold Pearson r (paper aggregation), arithmetic mean r also disclosed, reduced chi-square using original target sigma, mean fold HSE threat score using original HSEcalc. MAE and 500/600 threshold metrics secondary. Report undefined metrics explicitly. Paper baseline distinct from any modern port.
success: Predeclared candidate must improve mean fold RMSE and mean fold Pearson r versus released WindNet on identical windows; chi-square and HSE threat score reported, with a stricter all-four-metrics gate separately. Do not claim all-metric improvement unless all four pass. Validation adoption: >=1% RMSE improvement with no Pearson-r decrease; chi2/HSE are guardrails and disclosed tradeoffs.
stopping: At most six substantive development hypotheses or US$5 estimated incremental Runpod cost. Stop adaptation at freeze, regardless of final outcome. Improvement cannot be guaranteed and failure must be retained.
prior_exposure: Published historical holdout scores were already in this conversation before this request. This campaign is prospectively sealed against further test feedback, not a pristine blind or fresh confirmatory study.
publication: User explicitly authorized public RogNet campaign/experiments and commits pushed to GitHub. Dashboard remains owner-private by default.
